why_planted: Connects the benign lookalike's route through the suspicious case's device. D-568 was never used to send from A-9895 or A-1415.
The alert as a stream processor with no out-of-order allowance would have computed it: the late credit T0012 dropped, five senders and 2,810.00 instead of six and 3,570.00.
The path end an arrival-order lookup would report: the debit T0008 arrived before the credit T0007, so the lookup misses onward:T0007:T0008 and ends the path at A-5092 too early.
Cites a transfer that is not in the bounded dataset.
